create_config_glm4: create a Glm4Config instance with default parameters for the glm4-4-9b-chat model
initialize_glm4_model: initialize a Glm4Model with a Glm4Config for the zai-org/GLM-OCR checkpoint
inspect_glm4_config: inspect the Glm4Config attributes including vocab_size, hidden_size, and rope_parameters
configure_glm4_attention: configure Glm4Config with custom num_attention_heads, num_key_value_heads, and attention_bias settings
override_glm4_embeddings: override Glm4Config max_position_embeddings and hidden_size for a custom GLM4 model variant
